spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Select an olfactory indicator when colour-based indicators are unsuitable for the observer or task. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
